summary: Discussion-sourced signals: rising security incidents (agents escaping sandboxes, mcp CVEs, OpenAI rogue-agent probes), mainstream product chatter (OpenAI Dots, OpenHands, Claude Code UX), and concrete operator workflows (playbook vs Agent Skill, agent ownership). Prioritize verifying CVEs and official vendor responses. | Official-vendor feed: priority security advisories (Flowise GHSA), product rollouts (JetBrains, Cursor, Cloudflare), and infra primitives (E2B secrets, MCP SDK advisory). Missing independent social/operator reports for field impact. | Snapshot of GitHub OSS agent ecosystem: multiple vendor releases (GitHub Copilot, Cloudflare, Microsoft), high-traction agent frameworks (DeepSeek, Langflow, Dify), and infra primitives (langfuse, modelcontextprotocol, browser-use). Missing social/operator reports for user-workflow validation. | Package-shard screening: mix of VS Code agent extensions and registry packages for agent infra (eval, memory, telemetry, MCP). No social field reports in this shard; surface gaps for user-workflow signals.
